goal: Record clean guest OS architecture Python pip and Python-path state before installation
command: import importlib.metadata as m, json, os, platform, sys; print(json.dumps({"platform": platform.platform(), "machine": platform.machine(), "python": sys.version, "executable": sys.executable, "pip": m.version("pip"), "PYTHONPATH": os.environ.get("PYTHONPATH"), "cwd": os.getcwd()}, indent=2))
expected_behavior: The container reports Linux arm64 Python 3.11 and no inherited development path
interpretation: Exit status only; scientific/acceptance interpretation belongs in the report.
